course.title: Radar and Satellite Communication
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: A satellite at a distance of 40,000 km from a point on the earth's surface radiates a power of 2 W from the antenna with a gain of 17 dB in the direction of observer. Find the flux density at the receiving point and the power received by an antenna with an effective area of 10 m<sup>2</sup>.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
